title: Front-end features gated on the backoffice login
description: Front-end pages that read the backoffice login to show editor-only features.

impact.summary: The backoffice uses its own authentication scheme, so front-end checks of the backoffice login need a redesign.

handling.option: Move the feature into the backoffice, or redesign it with its own authorization (the user decides)

checks.text: The user has decided how the feature works on the target, and the decision is recorded
